title: The Practice's Accounting
subtitle: Dr. Amrani & Dr. Bennani are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 

Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani have just opened their dental practice.

Everything is going smoothly: patients are flocking in, treatments are flowing... but a shadow looms over their success.

The tax authorities are knocking at their door.

Is their accounting compliant with Law 9-88?
- Journal, general ledger, inventory book?
- Balance sheet, income statement, management balance sheet?
- Thresholds, deadlines, depreciation, exemptions?

One wrong move, and it's a penalty. 💸

Their accounting files are in YOUR hands.

chapters.debutant1: The Foundations of Accounting - Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani discover the fundamental principles of accounting according to Law 9-88. Journal, general ledger, financial statements... a whole universe to master.
chapters.debutant2: Depreciation and Taxation - Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani deepen their knowledge. They discover depreciation, inventory, provisions, and tax obligations.
chapters.intermediaire1: Financial Management - Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani learn to manage their practice with management tools: budgeting, dashboards, profitability analysis.
chapters.intermediaire2: Taxation - Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani must manage their tax obligations: VAT, CIT/PIT, declarations, audits. Every decision has a financial impact.
chapters.expert1: Tax Optimization - Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani become tax management experts. They optimize their practice structure and anticipate future changes.
chapters.expert2: Excellence and Succession - After years of rigorous management, Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani pass on their knowledge to young practitioners. Management is the soul of the practice's sustainability.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani have laid the foundations of their accounting management. But the road is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Depreciation and taxation are now mastered. Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani are ready for financial management.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Financial management is in place. Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani manage their practice with rigor.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Tax obligations are under control. Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani are confident before the tax authorities.
chapterEndings.expert1: Tax optimization is an asset. Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani train young dentists in management.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Amrani and Dr. Bennani have accomplished their mission. Management is the soul of the practice's sustainability.
